model.initial_sampling: Deterministic every-Nth subset of exact accepted200k realization; masses scaled conservatively; same cohort positions/velocities, not shifted onto spirals
model.scope: Calculated orbit/gas response to prescribed scalar potential; no live self-gravity, MHD, feedback, or claim of spontaneously generated spiral structure

rendering.camera: A; exact cubic interpolation in src/camera.py
rendering.display: Accepted radial contrast and D65 photographic adaptation
rendering.association_scope: Four persistent members; exact accepted source realization

shutter.integration: Equal weights in linear photon intensity after unchanged PSF; same nominal camera/physical clock; tone map once; first endpoint shuttercollapsed

rendering.scope: Native rendering only; no recalculation of dynamics, gas, star formation, spectra, opacity or line budget

radiation.IMF: Kroupa-like slopes 1.3/2.3 with continuity at 0.5 Msun; 0.08–100 Msun; unit initial mass integral
radiation.stellar_scope: Prescribed analytic main-sequence L/R/lifetimes; blackbody spectra; 5% lifetime integration smoothing; no detailed isochrones, binaries or metallicity evolution
radiation.nebular_density_cm3: clip(4*local mean gas density,10,200); prescribed clump closure
radiation.ionizing_remainder_scope: 35% prescribed dust absorption / escape combined; not a solved galactic UV transport field
radiation.display: CIE 1931 integration of stellar continuum 360–830 nm into linear sRGB, plus Case-B Halpha656.3/Hbeta486.1 with a fixed line gain; no JWST mid-IR colors or image texture
radiation.population_scope: IMF-integrated analytic main-sequence spectra/lifetimes plus prescribed giant bolometric fractions and M:L. Not MIST/FSPS synthesis or measured NGC628 populations.
radiation.birth_height_scope: Association centers in thin unresolved midplane; old/intermediate continuum has measured finite vertical thickness
radiation.ionized_mass_budget: 30% of each actual gas cell, shared among source centers in that cell; unused photons do not emit twice

presentation.spectral_convention: Unchanged CIE optical continuum and physical Halpha/Hbeta; display line gain4

transfer.scattering: Extinction includes absorption and scattering OUT of the beam. In-scattering and dust IR reradiation are omitted; no scattering glow is added.
transfer.old_source: Intrinsic mass/light field, then finite-height formal transfer with measured cohort vertical rms; no post-extinction kpc smoothing
transfer.young_source: Calculated midplane associations; smooth 80–120Myr transition to thin unresolved continuum; all intrinsic light conserved
transfer.bulge: Spherical analytic light; rear/front-half thin-screen approximation
transfer.emission: Gas-shared-mass and photon-limited Case-B regions; Te=10000K; clump ne=clip(4*mean gas n,10,200) cm^-3, filling factor0.01; R<=150pc; 10% diffuse redistribution over120pc

display.scope: Accepted fixed display; not extra source luminosity or a fitted arm mask
display.white_reference: 5772K photographic source adapted to D65; physical Y retained before tone

camera.projection: Native 3D orthographic rays; projected major axis lower-left to upper-right

old_light_quadrature.scope: Persistent statistical samples of unresolved existing emission, not individually resolved stars or extra mass;99% remains continuous

source_support.scope: Expanded stellar reconstruction buffer only; no new particles, altered radii or extended gas atmosphere

presentation.typography: The established three labels are composited last in screen space; dust never attenuates the labels
presentation.population_tables: Same frozen IMF/spectral/age lookups; candidate formation history is recalculated from its gas response

white_balance.meaning: Display chromatic adaptation only, not a new radiation spectrum or measured stellar temperature

presentation.shutter: Two equal linear-light midpoints over a centered 180-degree shutter; +/-1/(8*30)s. At playback0the shutter collapses to the endpoint. Tone/foreground text applied once.

encoding.output: H.264 High / yuv420p / Rec.709 limited / MP4
encoding.quantization: zscale error diffusion at final 8-bit conversion, not astrophysical texture or added decorative grain
